name: iam:PassRole + cloudformation:CreateStackSet + cloudformation:CreateStackInstances
description: A principal with iam:PassRole, cloudformation:CreateStackSet, and cloudformation:CreateStackInstances can escalate privileges by creating a new CloudFormation StackSet with a privileged execution role and then deploying stack instances to trigger resource provisioning. The two-step process is critical: CreateStackSet defines the template and execution role but deploys nothing, while CreateStackInstances actually provisions the resources defined in the template using the execution role's credentials. Both permissions are required. The attacker's template defines an IAM role with AdministratorAccess trusted by the attacker's principal; once the stack instance deployment succeeds, the attacker assumes that role to gain administrative access.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must have permission to pass the execution role to CloudFormation StackSets
Create a new CloudFormation StackSet with the malicious template
Deploy stack instances to trigger resource provisioning

additional.description: Poll for stack instance deployment status
Discover available privileged roles to use as the execution role

admin: A privileged IAM role must exist that can be passed as the StackSet execution role
The execution role must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess or equivalent)
An administration role must exist that trusts cloudformation.amazonaws.com and has permission to assume the execution role
lateral: A privileged IAM role must exist that can be passed as the StackSet execution role
The execution role must have elevated permissions to create the desired resources
An administration role must exist for StackSet operations

references.title: AWS IAM Privilege Escalation – Methods and Mitigation (Rhino Security Labs)
How to implement the principle of least privilege with CloudFormation StackSets (AWS Security Blog)

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: EXECUTION_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name of the IAM execution role to pass to CloudFormation StackSets (must have elevated permissions; CloudFormation assumes this role in each target account to create resources)

options.name: PAYLOAD
options.description: Payload type for the CloudFormation StackSet template (backdoor/attach-policy)

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the IAM administration role to pass via iam:PassRole (must trust cloudformation.amazonaws.com and be able to assume the execution role). Leave blank to auto-construct from account ID using the lab's default naming convention

options.name: STACKSET_NAME
options.description: Name for the new CloudFormation StackSet to create. Defaults to a timestamped pathrunner name

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for CloudFormation and IAM operations

options.name: ASSUME_ROLE
options.description: Attempt to assume the escalated role after the StackSet deployment completes

options.name: ESCALATED_ROLE_NAME
options.description: Name for the escalated IAM role to create (auto-generated if empty)

options.name: TRUST_PRINCIPAL
options.description: ARN to trust in the escalated role's trust policy (defaults to caller ARN)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete the StackSet and its stack instances after execution. Requires cloudformation:DeleteStackInstances and cloudformation:DeleteStackSet

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with AdministratorAccess trusted by the attacker's principal via CloudFormation template
